title: Sip 'N' Paint with Live Demonstration & Step-by-Step Guide | Art Jamming (Fully Guided) | BYOB!
description: Bring your own wine, beer, or bubble tea and spend 3 hours painting something you actually like — guided step-by-step by an art instructor. No experience needed, all materials provided. Great for a chill date night or a group hangout at a studio in Geylang, near MRT.
